headline: Audi Plans $4.2 Billion Investment for First U.S. Auto Plant
summary: German automaker Audi plans to invest $4.2 billion to build its first factory in the United States, targeting an annual production of 200,000 vehicles.
why: Audi is a premier luxury vehicle brand under the Volkswagen Group, and major capital expenditures of this scale significantly impact regional manufacturing and employment.

impacts.name: Automotive Manufacturing
impacts.why: A multi-billion dollar factory investment expands domestic production capacity and boosts local supply chains.

why_moved: A multi-billion dollar manufacturing expansion signals long-term growth and capital commitment to the domestic market.
